name: Omarchy Sync
author: jacueblol
description: Keep your Omarchy plugins, bar layout, keybindings, mouse settings, theme, and wallpaper the same on every machine through a private git repo you own. Choose what syncs and when, per machine. Works alongside Omaplug and Wallpaper Library.

barWidget.description: Sync plugins, bar layout, and config between machines

schema.label: Sync repo
schema.description: owner/name on GitHub, or any git URL you can push to. Leave empty and use Set up in the panel to create a private GitHub repo.

schema.label: Automatic sync
schema.description: Push automatically shares this machine's changes but only applies other machines' changes when you click Pull. Push and pull automatically also applies them without asking.

schema.label: When both machines changed
schema.description: Use the repo only applies automatically in Push and pull mode.

schema.label: Sync installed plugins
schema.description: Install plugins the other machine added, and sync which plugins are enabled.

schema.label: Remove plugins removed elsewhere
schema.description: Plugins with uncommitted local changes are never removed.

schema.label: Sync bar layout
schema.description: Widget order, bar position, and widget settings.

schema.label: Sync other shell settings
schema.description: Everything else in shell.json, such as idle and lock timers.

schema.label: Sync keybindings
schema.description: ~/.config/hypr/bindings.lua. Put bindings for this machine only in hypr/bindings.local.lua.

schema.label: Sync mouse and keyboard input
schema.description: ~/.config/hypr/input.lua: sensitivity, acceleration, scrolling, keyboard layout. Put settings for this machine only in hypr/input.local.lua.

schema.label: Other files to sync
schema.description: Comma-separated paths under ~/.config, such as hypr/looknfeel.lua or starship.toml. Synced files are never deleted by a sync.

schema.label: Sync theme and wallpaper
schema.description: The current theme, themes you installed or made, and the current wallpaper. Wallpapers from outside the Wallpaper Library and hand-made themes are copied into the sync repo, which grows with every change.

schema.label: Sync Wallpaper Library categories
schema.description: Needs the Wallpaper Library plugin. Downloads the dharmx/walls categories other machines have. Each category can be tens to hundreds of MB; the full library is several GB.

schema.label: Machine-specific plugins
schema.description: Comma-separated plugin ids that stay on this machine only: never installed, removed, or moved by a sync.
